QUOTE: "defines it as `private_##member` when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is not defined, and as plain `member` when it is. A consumer who writes `ctx.reseed_counter` gets a compile error because the field is actually called `private_reseed_counter`." and "For code in those places, every `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to `x`... Everywhere else, the same access fails to build."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining the opt-out macro sees plain member names, while other consumers see the `private_`-prefixed names.
